prompt: Haloform reaction: 2-butanone + excess Br2, NaOH. Draw the organic products (two).
explanation: Methyl ketones (R-CO-CH3) undergo tri-α-halogenation on the methyl side (each halogenation makes the α-H more acidic). The CBr3⁻ leaves as a stable leaving group when hydroxide attacks the C=O → carboxylate + CHBr3 (bromoform). This is the iodoform test when I2 is used (yellow CHI3 precipitates).
